title: overlapping work is told again when a claim opens its pull request
status: fixed after 0.4.1: a claim and the pull requests from its branch are one piece, named by the issue in the overlap markers and told on it, a marker on the claim's own pull request counting as one on the issue and a marker counting for a claim only from the push that made its branch (board.identity, coordinator.heard_of; DESIGN.md, 13)

steps.note: the board shows the work by its pull request now, and nothing is told again: the two pieces are named by their issues, #1 and #2, and were told on them at step 2; until the fix the work was named by #100 and told on it, and #2 heard of #100 as if it were new work (the order shown, the lower number first, is a tie by age broken by number, which the spec reads the same way)

an issue's number names each claim on it in turn: a's claim on #1 was released at hour 25 and c's is new work, so the markers from hour 0, #1's naming 2 and #2's naming 1, told of a's, and both are told again; until the review of the fix they counted, and neither was ever told
the coordinator before the fix told a claim's work on its pull request once it had one, and named it by that number

the upgrade tells nothing again: the markers on the claims' own pull requests count as the issues', their numbers read as the claims; until the review of the fix only the issues were read, and both claims were told again
